title: MapQuest is now the No. 1 US app after bucking Trump's 'Lake America' renaming | TechCrunch
summary: The surge in new downloads was inspired by MapQuest’s refusal to rename Lake Ontario as “Lake America,” after President Trump’s executive order directed the U.S. geographic naming service to adopt the new name amid his ongoing trade push.
